dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a natural number n, this is the type of square matrices whose rows and columns are indexed by Fin n and whose entries are real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes A, dA, B, dB, and E arbitrary real n by n matrices of the same dimension.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a real n by n matrix X, this is sqrt(sum over i in Fin n of sum over j in Fin n of (X i j)^2), namely its Frobenius norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the norm on the constructed matrix on the left and on each of E, A, dB, dA, and B on the right.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: It maps A, dA, B, dB, and E to the matrix E + (A*dB + (dA*B + dA*dB)), where the products are matrix products and the additions are matrix additions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the exact matrix whose Frobenius norm appears on the left-hand side.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: It is ordinary matrix multiplication for two compatible real matrices, implemented by the matrix HMul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the three matrix products A*dB, dA*B, and dA*dB inside LocalDef003.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the binary heterogeneous-addition operation supplied by an HAdd instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the selected instances it denotes ordinary real addition on the right-hand side and pointwise matrix addition inside LocalDef003.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the binary heterogeneous-multiplication operation supplied by an HMul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the real-number instance it denotes the scalar products of Frobenius norms on the right-hand side; the matrix multiplication instance supplies the products used by LocalDef004.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the less-than-or-equal relation supplied by an LE instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the real-number ordering instance it makes the conclusion an inequality between real numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the type of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the type of the matrix dimension n and also the exponent type used for squaring entries.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrix entries, norms, scalar products, sums, and both sides of the inequality are real-valued.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: This equips the real numbers with their ordinary addition operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the additions among the real-valued terms on the right and underlies pointwise addition of real matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: This equips the real numbers with their ordinary less-than-or-equal relation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the proposition's comparison as the usual real inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: This equips the real numbers with their ordinary multiplication operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets products of norms, products of matrix entries in matrix multiplication, and multiplication involved in entry powers.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any type with an Add operation, this creates an HAdd instance on that same type using the given addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It turns ordinary real addition into the HAdd operations on the right and pointwise matrix addition into the HAdd operations in LocalDef003.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: For any type with a Mul operation, this creates an HMul instance on that same type using the given multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It turns ordinary real multiplication into the scalar norm products on the right-hand side.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite type of natural-number indices strictly below n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes the n rows and n columns of every matrix and the two finite sums defining each Frobenius norm.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: This gives Fin n its finite enumeration as a Fintype.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits summation over all row and column indices and supplies the finite intermediate index set for matrix multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: This adds the values of a function over a finite set using an additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The two nested uses add all squared entries in the definition of each Frobenius norm.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a finite type, this is the finite set containing every element of that type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Each norm sum ranges over every i and every j in Fin n, with no omitted matrix entries.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: This projects the heterogeneous exponentiation operation supplied by an HPow instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets (X i j)^2 in every norm definition.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix
dependency_coverage.meaning: A matrix with row type m, column type n, and entry type alpha is definitionally a function m -> n -> alpha.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Each matrix is therefore an entry function Fin n -> Fin n -> Real.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.add
dependency_coverage.meaning: This equips matrices with pointwise addition inherited from addition of their entries.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The matrix sum in LocalDef003 is entrywise: corresponding entries of E and the three matrix products are added.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: This equips a monoid with natural-number exponentiation by repeated multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For real entries it gives the natural power used in (X i j)^2.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets a natural-number numeral in a type having the corresponding OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the literal numeral 2 used as the exponent in each squared matrix entry.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the additive commutative monoid structure of the real numbers, including zero, associative and commutative addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It enables the finite sums in the Frobenius norm and the finite dot-product sums in matrix multiplication, including empty sums when n is zero.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: This supplies the multiplicative monoid structure of the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies natural-number exponentiation of real entries, in particular their squares.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.sqrt
dependency_coverage.meaning: This is the nonnegative real square-root operation, defined through the square root of the nonnegative-real part of its input; it returns zero on negative inputs.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is applied to a nonnegative sum of real squares, so each LocalDef002 value is the ordinary nonnegative square root of that sum.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Given a Pow operation from exponents of type beta on bases of type alpha, this creates the corresponding HPow alpha beta alpha instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It exposes real natural-number exponentiation as the operation used to square matrix entries.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: This interprets each natural-number numeral as that same value in Nat.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the exponent literal 2 exactly the natural number two.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: For matrices over a finite intermediate index type, this defines matrix multiplication by (M*N)(i,k) equal to the dot product of row i of M and column k of N, namely the finite sum over j of M(i,j)*N(j,k).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With all index types equal to Fin n and entries real, it gives the ordinary n by n matrix products A*dB, dA*B, and dA*dB.

binders: n is an arbitrary natural number.
A, dA, B, dB, and E are arbitrary real n by n matrices.
conclusions: The Frobenius norm of E + (A*dB + (dA*B + dA*dB)) is at most (((the Frobenius norm of E) + (the Frobenius norm of A)(the Frobenius norm of dB)) + (the Frobenius norm of dA)(the Frobenius norm of B)) + (the Frobenius norm of dA)(the Frobenius norm of dB).
mathematical_definitions: For any real n by n matrix X, ||X||_F := sqrt(sum_{i in Fin n} sum_{j in Fin n} X(i,j)^2).
For real n by n matrices X and Y, (XY)(i,k) := sum_{j in Fin n} X(i,j)Y(j,k).
The matrix on the left is exactly S := E + (A*dB + (dA*B + dA*dB)); equivalently by associativity, S = E + A*dB + dA*B + dA*dB.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every natural number n and all real n by n matrices A, dA, B, dB, and E, ||E + A*dB + dA*B + dA*dB||_F is at most ||E||_F + ||A||_F||dB||_F + ||dA||_F||B||_F + ||dA||_F||dB||_F.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: All five matrices are square, real-valued, and have the same dimension n.
There is no assumption that n is positive. When n = 0, all index sets and norm sums are empty, all displayed norms are zero, and the conclusion reduces to 0 <= 0.
There are no hypotheses concerning invertibility, nonzero matrices, conditioning, ranks, or bounds on any matrix.
Despite their suggestive names, dA and dB are arbitrary matrices; the proposition does not encode that they are small perturbations or differences between other matrices.
E is arbitrary and is not required to be an error, residual, or quantity related to A, B, dA, or dB.
The norm is specifically the entrywise Euclidean/Frobenius norm, not an induced operator norm or another matrix norm.
The cross term dA*dB is included exactly; no first-order approximation discards it.
All operations are exact real arithmetic. No floating-point format, rounding operation, computed approximation, or numerical error model is encoded.
The proposition states only this upper bound and does not assert equality, sharpness, or a lower bound.
